dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Do you mean the passing of Rex Lapis? I've already heard about that.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: When that incident took place, the lockdown of Inazuma had already happened, so I also missed the Rite of Parting.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm still a bit broken up about it. I'm sure every Liyue citizen would've grieved too...
